content: Outcast Part 1 By Raymond Bayly The horizon lit with the last of the  rocket trails  caused by the fleeing ships as they ascended into the heavens, the future of the human race, put on a shelf in case the  engine was truly the doomsday device the entire project thought it was Brandon thought as he stood atop the cliff peering out over the Georgia  skyline as the sunset, the sky awash with pink and white  began to darken into evening.
